# hiok_mongo_cluster (Resource)

A managed MongoDB cluster. One region gives a single node; several give a replica set with a member in each.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String)

### Optional

- `consistency` (String) "strong", "session", "bounded" or "eventual". This sets the read concern, write concern and read preference in the connection string, so it governs your drivers. The last two read from secondaries and need more than one region.
- `database_name` (String)
- `engine_version` (String)
- `max_staleness_seconds` (Number) Lag ceiling for bounded staleness reads. MongoDB's minimum is 90.
- `region` (String)
- `regions` (List of String) One member per region. The first holds the primary and takes every write.
- `resource_group_id` (String) Resource group the resource is placed in.
- `sku` (String)
- `storage_gb` (Number)
- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription the resource is billed to.
- `vnet_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `connection_string` (String, Sensitive) Carries the administrator password, so it is marked sensitive.
- `host` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_replica_set` (Boolean)
- `port` (Number)
- `read_concern` (String)
- `read_preference` (String)
- `replica_set_name` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `status_message` (String) Why the cluster is degraded, when it is.
- `write_concern` (String)
